info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v3-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Limit API enables users to access and retrieve the current limits associated with credit card applications. This endpoint provides essential insights into the thresholds for various credit card application submissions, facilitating informed decisions for prospective clients. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, application developers, and business analysts seeking to streamline credit processing operations. By efficiently managing application limits, businesses can improve service delivery and enhance customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the maximum number of applications that can be processed. It provides vital information for managing application submissions effectively.
